GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down 9 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 10 Lengths Two Wide turning, made up 5 Lengths in Straight against a winner racing away. Only runner to take ground off winner in straight. # got a long way back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When under pressure in the home straight, laid in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down rear 3 Wide 9 Lengths out Four Wide Turning for home Ridden Along couldn't finish off - had no favours - # sat back 3 Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced wide for the majority.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Not Bustled Settled Down 11th Inside 10 Lengths 9th x 800m with 1st following 2 Lengths behind, Under Pressure x 400m Just Kept Going One Pace couldn't quicken - # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear running over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1.2 Lengths Quickly across to the fence settled down second last 9 Lengths (1200m), last 600 awkwardly placed, off rail & with a back to follow Soon After , cornered last, hooked deep hit the line very well # from last turn!

Slow Out 1.0 Lengths across to the fence settled fourth last 8 Lengths (1400m), urged along 600 improving off fence, within 4 Lengths 300 all out though, stayed on right to the line Without threat # sound/gave all

Slow Out 1.0 Lengths settled down worse Mid Field fence 8 Lengths (1000m), off fence before Turn , Straightened Up Ridden Along shifting wider, Under Whip last 150 made Ground into fourth # tardy/ran on

Slow Out 0.5 Lengths more the case no early speed Settled Down third last fence 6-7 Lengths (1000m), Saved Ground Turn & into the Straight , no room 200, held up badly Soon After couldn't get a crack at them # very unlucky
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early stages of the home straight. Held up near the 150m on heels for a number of strides and was unable to be fully tested to the finish line when racing close to heels over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to Turn then Hooked Out to 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Four Wide Straightening Up but lost a length in Straight # never a real threat

Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, little change to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages and got its head up.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early and got its head up.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 7 Lengths turning, shifted wider Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # slowly away
Jumped awkwardly missing the start 3 Lengths and Settled Down last 12 Lengths from the lead, Made Some Ground to 9 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # Blew start badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Laid out rounding the turn approaching the 1200m and when being steadied raced ungenerously with its head up for a short distance and near the 1100m was then restrained from heels. Rounding the home turn improved up behind runners before shifting in to obtain clear running. Laid in from the 200m until approaching the 100m when disappointed for a run, before shifting out near the 75m to obtain clear running.
